title: Anne of Green Gables
author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
summary: An elderly brother and sister on Prince Edward Island ask for a boy to help on the farm and get a talkative, imaginative red-haired orphan girl instead. Anne wins her way into their lives and the village.
readIf: you like a cosy, funny, big-hearted story about an imaginative girl growing up.
skipIf: you want fast pacing or high stakes; it's gentle and episodic.

pairings.reason: Another much-loved coming-of-age classic centred on a spirited, writerly girl.
A shorter story of a child changed by a new place and the people in it.
Another orphan placed with an unlikely guardian and loving the landscape around her.
